claim: Native zizmor1.30.1 on macOS accepts the published workflow under offline regular analysis and rejects an inert unsafe fixture with three findings; two executable regression checks pass.
limitations: Offline regular analysis is scoped static evidence, not absence of every vulnerability or signature verification.
Mac binary and the checksum-locked Linux CI wheel are distinct artifacts; new runner execution is established by its own CI result.
